ننتوي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَوِي (nantawī) /nan.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
# نَنْتَوِيَ (nantawiya) /nan.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
